title: Frozen Scenes, Shifting Winners: Configuration Fragility in Text-to-3D Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.00447v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Can a text-to-3D leaderboard change when every generated scene stays fixed? We audit this question for rendered-image evaluation, where camera settings and caption wording become part of the measurement protocol. Across 300 frozen scenes from six generators, we vary eight render and caption factors for 19 alignment evaluators plus one perceptual-quality control, then test four targeted scene degradations. Peak configuration variance exceeds between-generator variance for 17/19 alignment evaluators, with prompt-bootstrap lower bounds above 1 for 11/19. Rankings are more stable than scores, yet 18/19 evaluators change their point-estimate winner under some configuration. Pairwise protocol margin envelopes show which comparisons keep their direction across the tested settings. translated_title: 冻结场景，更迭赢家：文本到3D评估中的配置脆弱性
translated_abstract: 当所有生成的场景保持固定不变时，文本到3D（text-to-3D）排行榜还会发生变化吗？我们针对渲染图像评估对这一问题进行了审计，在此类评估中，相机设置与描述文本的措辞成为了测量协议的一部分。在来自六个生成器的300个冻结场景上，我们针对19个对齐评估器外加1个感知质量对照指标，变化了八种渲染与描述文本因素，随后测试了四种针对性的场景退化。结果发现：对于19个对齐评估器中的17个，峰值配置方差超过了生成器间的方差，其中11个评估器的提示词自助法（prompt-bootstrap）下界大于1。排名虽然比分数更稳定，但在某些配置下，19个评估器中有18个会改变其点估计赢家。成对协议边际包络显示哪些比较在所测试的设置中保持方向不变。选定的配对虽然具有方向相反的逐点区间，但在对完整搜索进行同时推断后，没有任何排名逆转能够存续。因此，所观察到的赢家变化是描述性的……
tldr: 该论文通过对来自六个生成器的300个冻结场景系统性变化八种渲染与描述文本配置因素，揭示文本到3D评估结果对配置高度脆弱——17/19个对齐评估器的配置方差超过生成器间方差，且18/19个评估器在某些配置下会改变点估计赢家，表明当前评估协议存在严重的不稳定性。
en_tdlr: By systematically varying eight render and caption configuration factors across 300 frozen scenes from six generators, this paper reveals the fragility of text-to-3D evaluation: configuration variance exceeds between-generator variance for 17 of 19 alignment evaluators, and 18 of 19 evaluators change their point-estimate winner under some configuration, though no ranking reversal survives simultaneous inference over the full search.
